content.short: StarkNet React is a collection of React providers and hooks for StarkNet.
content.description: StarkNet React is a library that provides a cohesive set of React hooks for building on StarkNet. Following a wagmi-inspired design, it offers a simple, declarative approach to integrating StarkNet concepts into React applications. The hooks are implemented on top of starknet.js, delivering a consistent layer for composing StarkNet interactions in front-end code. This project aims to streamline development, reduce boilerplate, and help developers create robust, testable StarkNet experiences within React ecosystems.
